title: T1011 — Exfiltration Over Other Network Medium
subtitle: The animation shows a simple insider case.
aria: T1011 - Exfiltration Over Other Network Medium

nodes.label: Sensitive data
nodes.tip: Sensitive data - What is at risk

steps.title: Restricted zone access
steps.caption: The insider badges into the restricted lab and plugs a personal USB 4G modem into a lab endpoint. The endpoint accepts it because users keep local admin rights. EDR device control records a new network adapter, but nobody has tuned an alert for that event yet
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Collect
steps.caption: The insider copies program files into a single archive and parks it on the endpoint. This staging step is invisible to network monitoring. lab assets normally upload nothing, so a zero baseline would make any transfer stand out if someone measured it
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

steps.title: Hotspot association
steps.caption: The endpoint joins the personal hotspot over Wi-Fi. The network name is not on the company allowlist. a wireless sensor notes the new SSID association near the lab
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

steps.title: Upload
steps.caption: The archive moves to the hotspot and on to a cloud account in staggered chunks over the cellular link. Nothing crosses the corporate firewall or proxy. egress logs stay completely silent, which is exactly the blind spot this page is about
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

steps.title: Data lands
steps.caption: The cloud account now holds the stolen data, and the attacker shares the folder with a second personal account. The copy is outside every company control. no company system can see this step at all
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

steps.title: WIPS flag
steps.caption: The wireless intrusion prevention sensor reports an unknown access point close to the lab floor. WIPS stands for Wireless Intrusion Prevention System. an alert lands in the queue and now needs correlation with endpoint data
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

steps.title: Endpoint cross-check
steps.caption: The analyst queries the EDR agent for device history. EDR stands for Endpoint Detection and Response. the agent shows a cellular adapter was plugged in minutes before the WIPS alert, so the two stories match
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

detection.label: Alert raised
detection.detail: The SOC has enough evidence to open an incident.

steps.title: Response
steps.caption: The team isolates the endpoint remotely and confiscates the modem during a supervised visit. A physical sweep of the lab follows. the incident closes with device control tightened and the Wi-Fi policy updated
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.
